snippet.title: Deadline - Video Game Trailer (1996, PC MS-DOS)
snippet.description:
Deadline   : official  Trailer (1996)
Game developped  by Millennium Interactive Ltd. 
Published by Psygnosis Limited for PC (DOS) in 1996.
Published in USA by Nova Spring (a Vic Tokai subsidiary).

Systems : PC (DOS).

Video file  found on the cover disc from french magazine Génération 4 (Issue #91, September 1996)
